notes.title: Achievements and more
notes.content:
[b]Achievements [/b]

There are now four achievements to get in the story mode, go through the whole story mode to get all four achievements are find out what is going on in town. 

[b]More Story[/b]

The story mode has been extended with a new ending.

[b]Graphics[/b]

Replaced the floor and some furniture with improved art work.

[b]General Improvements [/b]

Other general improvements to improve the gameplay.

notes.title: Upcoming content
notes.content:
Hello,

I will be adding some achievements and general improvements. Thanks

notes.title: Boost Display
notes.content: There is now a boost display so you can run by the cats and know when you are ready to run again! plus lots of other fixes.

notes.title: New Level and other improvements
notes.content:
[b]Lab[/b]

Another story level has been added, try and survive four nights of cleaning a laboratory, but while you clean be careful as their experiment has escaped. 

[b]Menu[/b]

I cleaned up the menu and made it a be easier to navigate.

notes.title: Another Level Added Gallery
notes.content:
Another level has been added and a load of other improvements. Another level has been added called Gallery. You have to clean a gallery but be careful of breaking the paintings.

Also the gameplay has been adjusted, it should move a bit quicker.

notes.title: Another Level Added
notes.content: Another level has been added to the challenge mode, The level is a grocery store. Try and clean the store and get the best score possible.

notes.title: bug fixes
notes.content: fixed the problem with the vaccum cleaner and box collisions

notes.title: More added to story mode and more
notes.content:
Story Mode

There is another section to story mode which has been added.

User Interface

There is now more infromation from your boss as you play through the game which will be on the user interface.

There has been a lot of bugs which have been fixed, some bugs which would effect the score and cleaning some buildings.

notes.title: menu improvements and other fixes
notes.content: there is now a scrollable part of the menu to select levels. There will be another section added to the story mode soon.

notes.title: Another level to story mode and other fixes
notes.content:
[b]Story Mode Level
[/b]
Story mode has another area to unlock as you progress through it, The forest has been extented and there is a grocery store. That you can clean.

[b]Interface Upgrade
[/b]
the user interface has been updated and the score should be placed at the top of your screen and scale with whatever resolution you choose. 

I will have other levels coming soon. Thanks.

notes.title: Released
notes.content: The game is released and thanks so much for the support. I shall be working on some updates over then few months. I know there are a few problems with the game which I have listed in the discussions section. If you come across any problems or any suggestions please post them in the forum too. Thanks

notes.title: Werewolfs and Superstores
notes.content:
Hey guys,

So the game will start in early access, I will keep it in early access for a year until everything is smooth, while adding some more features.

[b]Super Store[/b]

So the first few things which will be added to the game will be a stand alone level, Which you can clean at your own pace. It will be a super store, you will have to avoid customer and make sure you do not make a mess as you navigate the level.

The second part will be adding will be.

[b]Were Wolf Forest[/b]

when you play the story mode, which is an open map. It has lots of buisnesses to visit. But down below is a forest, where there will be some other customers who need your help cleaning their homes or buisnesses however there will be a werewolf lurking in the forest which you will have to avoid. if he catches you, you will have to start in the main village area again.
